candidates.change_summary: Replace the unlockTime assignment so it always sets unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing shorter unlock times.
Replace the unlockTime assignment so it always sets unlockTime to the current block.timestamp (ignoring the provided value), preventing users from extending the lock via _unlockTime.
Replace the balance update to overwrite acc.balance with msg.value instead of adding, changing how deposited amounts accumulate.
Replace the require check with a stricter check that forbids zero-value deposits by requiring msg.value > 0.
Insert an early return when msg.value is zero, so Put does nothing (no Log) on zero-value calls.

Replace the subtraction assignment acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am); with subtraction after external call (move the state update to after the call), so balance is decreased only if the external transfer succeeds.
Replace the external call to msg.sender.call with a send-style call using transfer (which reverts on failure and forwards 2300 gas), changing transfer semantics.
Replace the require-block timestamp check to use >= instead of >, allowing collection when block.timestamp equals unlockTime.
